7300 / 7200: Cortech Endurance Locker
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-7300-endurance-locker-lockable-property-storage-unit
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/endurance-locker/
Spec sheets: 7300 / 7200, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Locker – 7300 / 7200
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Locker - One-Piece Rotationally Molded Lockable Property Storage Unit - Model 7300
Subtitle: Molded Property Storage Locker with Combination Lock, Anti-Ligature Clothes Shelf, and No Metal Hinges
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 7200 / 7300 Endurance Lockable Property Storage Locker
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Locker is a full-height molded property storage locker for patient rooms, housing units, and other secure settings. It has 7.75 cu ft of storage on two fixed internal shelves, an anti-ligature shelf for hanging clothes, and a top shelf for additional storage.
The locker is rotationally molded from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no wood components. The 7300 has a door with a flush-mounted Master Lock combination lock and center key override, and the door hinges are molded plastic, with no metal hinges. The 7200 is the same locker without a door. Both bolt to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice.
Material: Rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no wood components
Storage: 7.75 cu ft of internal shelf storage, with two non-removable shelves, an anti-ligature shelf for hanging clothes, and a top shelf for additional storage
Interior: Slightly sloped for easy washing and drainage
Lock (7300): Flush-mounted Master Lock combination lock with center key override; master keys available on request so staff can override the combination
Hinges (7300): Molded plastic interior hinging system, with no metal hinges
Dimensions: 26”W×26”D×78½”H
Mounting: Bolts to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
7300 – Locker with Door: Combination lock with center key override
7200 – Locker without Door: Open locker with no door or lock
Installation and Options
Wall Mounting: Drill the ten mounting points on the back of the locker, mark the wall, and bolt the locker to the wall with ten security Torx anchor bolts and flat washers in holes at least 2” deep; see Cortech instructions
[H2] Applications
The Endurance Locker suits rooms where residents need secure, private storage for clothing and personal property.
Typical applications include:
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Housing units and dormitories in correctional facilities and jails
Residential treatment centers and shelters
Explore Anchortex's Prison & Detention Inmate Property Storage Solutions collection for more property boxes, garment bags, and storage lockers.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (51 characters): Cortech Endurance Locker - 7300 / 7200 at Anchortex
Meta description (151 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Locker. A molded 7.75 cu ft property storage locker with combination lock, anti-ligature clothes shelf, and no metal hinges.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out "One-Piece Rotationally Molded Lockable Property Storage Unit" and "Model," and added the 7200.
Weight: both variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet does not give a weight for the locker, so I left weight out. Can you get it from Cortech?
Material: your current page says "No steel or wood components." The Cortech spec sheet says "No wood components" (the 7300 has a metal lock), so I used that.
Mounting: your current page says "Stand alone or bolt to the wall." The Cortech spec sheet says it bolts to the wall, so I used that.
I left out "Molded-in shelving for open storage of personal items" and "Stain resistant," since the Cortech spec sheet does not say these for the locker.
Installation hardware: the Cortech instructions show ten anchor bolts but give two lengths (3.75” and 2.50”), so I did not give a bolt size.
Collection link: I linked the Prison & Detention Inmate Property Storage collection, the same as on the Barracuda Box and Master Box pages.
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I added it.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Product images: the page has seven images: five colors, the older color chart (image 6), and a closed and open view. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like the chart replaced?
